asserts.comment: Successful borrow transitions: Borrow CTA gone, Read+Remove appear at bottom. Library attribution shows Palace Bookshelf (which library this loan is in). This is the strongest mutation-killing assertion: any code path that fails to register the borrow OR fails to refresh the detail view would leave Borrow visible, which the assert flags.

kills_mutants.rationale: borrow flow completion writes to registry → if registry write is mutated, no Read button appears
action button state machine — flipping the borrow→loaned transition leaves Borrow visible
BorrowReducer state transitions; failure to emit .loaned action leaves stale Borrow CTA
